newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales -9.8 pct Dec 1-10 vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales -9.8 pct Dec 1-10 vs 1995.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales declined 9.8 percent in the first 10 days of December compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
Domestic car sales fell 13.5 percent to 145,209, while domestic truck sales dipped 5.2 percent to 130,667, CNW said.
Import car sales declined 9.5 percent to 33,307, and import truck sales dropped 13.6 percent to 6,589, it said.
Of the vehicles sold during the December 1-10 period, 36.2 percent were leased, up from 34.6 percent a year ago, CNW said.
